Dylan / team — quick technical summary: the Private connector supports configurable PII redaction. By default we replace user identifiers with stable hashed ids but do not surface an external request_id unless the customer opts into request-level telemetry (opt-in flag in the connector config). That opt-in is disabled in the LumenWave test deployment.

Two remediation paths:
- Quick runbook change (minutes-hours): enable request_id in connector config for the certification window and route logs to a dedicated, ephemeral audit bucket with short retention. Requires LumenWave sign-off and updated config push.
- Code change (days): add a dual-headed telemetry mode that emits both hashed_user_id and request_id with consent gating and masking rules. More secure but will slip the certification window.

I recommend the runbook approach for certification to avoid delaying the launch; follow-up with product for the dual-headed approach.

Mateo
Integration Engineer, Redwood Inference
